definition: The Loc-RIB is the routing table a BGP speaker builds from the routes it has received. A route server usually keeps one Loc-RIB for all its clients, but it can keep a separate Loc-RIB per client where clients have conflicting routing policies, at the cost of more CPU and memory.
plainLanguage: The routing table the route server itself uses when it decides which paths to send out to each client.
